assets.title: 1st Baptist Church Nashville

assets.title: York Guildhall Council Chamber
assets.modifications: First two channels extracted from a four-channel B-format recording; resampled from 96 kHz, converted from 24-bit to 16-bit PCM and shortened from 5 to approximately 2.50 seconds, with tail/silence edits.
